chunks: And whoever seeks a way other than submission to God, it will not be accepted from him, and he will be a loser in the world to come.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to seek a religion other than Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted to mean that 'Islam' refers specifically to the religion of the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, implying that deviation from their guidance constitutes a loss of one's faith. It underscores the necessity of adhering to the true path of submission as defined by divine authority, warning that mere nominal adherence without following the Imams' teachings renders deeds void. This highlights the Shia view that salvation is inextricably linked to recognizing and following the rightful successors of the Prophet.
